5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.background: Linea runs weekend trains from Dublin to Galway and wants more couples and families to take them.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.objectives: Lift weekend return bookings by 12% over the summer.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.audience: Couples and young families in Dublin who drive west two or three weekends a year and arrive tired.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.insight: A drive is a job somebody has to do. A train journey is time somebody gives back to you.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.smp: The weekend starts when you sit down.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.desired_response: Think the train is quicker than I assumed. Feel the trip is part of the break. Book a weekend return.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.mandatories: Weekend return fare. No anti-car tone (shared regional partners).
